an4.236:2.1: Katamañ ca bhikkhave kammaṃ kaṇhaṃ kaṇhavipākaṃ?
an4.236:2.2: Idha bhikkhave ekacco mātā-jīvitā voropitā hoti, pitā-jīvitā voropitā hoti, arahaṃ-jīvitā voropitā hoti, Tathāgatassa paduṭṭhena cittena lohitaṃ uppāditā hoti, saṅgho pi bhinno hoti.
an4.236:2.3: Idaṃ vuccati bhikkhave kammaṃ kaṇhaṃ kaṇhavipākaṃ. 8.
an4.236:3.1: Katamañ ca bhikkhave kammaṃ sukkaṃ sukkavipākaṃ?
an4.236:3.2: Idha bhikkhave ekacco pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti . . . samphappalāpā paṭivirato hoti, anabhijjhālū hoti, avyāpannacitto hoti, sammādiṭṭhiko hoti.
an4.236:3.3: Idaṃ vuccati bhikkhave kammaṃ sukkaṃ sukkavipākaṃ. 9.
an4.236:4.1: Katamañ ca bhikkhave kammaṃ kaṇhasukkaṃ kaṇhasukkavipākaṃ?
an4.236:4.2: Idha bhikkhave ekacco savyāpajjham pi avyāpajjham pi kāyasaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti . . . pe . . . [232. 4]. Idaṃ vuccati bhikkhave kammaṃ kaṇhasukkaṃ kaṇhasukkavipākaṃ. 10.
an4.236:5.1: Katamañ ca bhikkhave kammaṃ akaṇhamasukkaṃ akaṇha-asukkavipākaṃ kammaṃ kammakkhayāya saṃvattati?
an4.236:5.2: Tatra bhikkhave yam idaṃ kammaṃ kaṇhaṃ kaṇhavipākaṃ . . . pe . . . [232. 5] idaṃ vuccati bhikkhave kammaṃ akaṇhamasukkaṃ akaṇha-asukkavipākaṃ kammaṃ kammakkhayāya saṃvattati.
an4.236:5.3: Imāni kho bhikkhave cattāri kammāni mayā sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā paveditānīti. 235. 1.
